plugins.name: devteam
plugins.description: A lean, credit-efficient dev team for Claude Code: TDD feature pipeline, project pipeline with cross-chat continuity, requirements discovery, systematic debugging, self-improvement retros, ADRs, repo hygiene, graph-aware context economy (optional Graphify), an edgy-modern design direction (/edge), a plain-language house voice (Plain output style), a money-gate hook that forces a permission prompt on anything that bills, an eval suite, plus architect / test-guardian / design-reviewer agents.
